notes.title: GOST of Time – Official Game Launch on October 10, 2024!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, I want to thank everyone who purchased OVIVO. It’s really awesome that even after 7 years since its release, people are still reaching out and showing interest in the game. Some have been asking about a sequel, but we’d like to move forward, so I’m excited to introduce our new game: GOST of Time – 42 and More Ways of Using Your Own Dead Body in Time Travel.

GOST of Time is an absurdist top-down action and puzzle game with time-travel mechanics. We’re thrilled to announce that the game will be released in one week on October 10, 2024. I hope you enjoy it as much as you did OVIVO!

Add GOST of Time to your Wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076100/GOST_of_Time/
[previewyoutube=d9N_h_JrV0Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Introducing GOST of Time: A Puzzle Action Game!
notes.notes:
Hello folks! It's been a while, but we have some exciting news for all Steam users who loved our previous game OVIVO. As fans of Hotline Miami and Harry Potter and the Methods of Rationality, we embarked on a new adventure in the top-down shooter genre with a twist!

Introducing GOST of Time! It's a puzzle action game where your every move is recorded and played back when you meet your untimely demise. Your mission is to grab pills, solve intricate puzzles, avoid all sorts of perilous traps, and collect nostalgic artifacts from the past.

But here's the kicker: you won't be alone on this journey. As you navigate the mysteries of time, you'll encounter your past selves, collaborating and working together to overcome challenges. It's like a team-building exercise where the only team member is... well, you!
GLHF!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076100/GOST_of_Time/

notes.title: FIXED: Achievements Bug
notes.notes:
Hi folks! We have finally fixed the issue when the game didn't give the last two achievements (all dots collected and all symbols collected). Just update the game and you will receive achievements if you had reached them.

Thank you for your support and patient. We are so grateful that our game after all these years still has such attention. 
Cheers!

notes.title: OVIVO Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Hi Folks! 
We have great update of our game OVIVO on Steam. 

- New music tracks. 
Folks, we know you love original tracks but we had to change the tracks because of the copyright issues. We asked the composer(Brokenkites) to make a special version of his tracks for OVIVO. The new tracks came out great and we think that they fit the game even better.

- New feature (only for Windows and Linux)
We’ve added a special liquid like effect when OVO switches between Black and White worlds.

- Artbook
We’ve also release an artbook for the game with the full story of the OVIVO world and our commentary. It is released as part of the OVIVO Soundtrack DLC. Current owners of the DLC should get the artbook after update. 

Don’t miss the chance to buy OVIVO with 70% discount on Steam Black Friday Sale!
